title: Sony BRAVIA 4K GB (EU: device BRAVIA_ATV2_EU, product BRAVIA_ATV2). Android TV 9 (API 28).
header:
Sony BRAVIA 4K GB (EU: device BRAVIA_ATV2_EU, product BRAVIA_ATV2). Android TV 9 (API 28).
Firmware BRAVIA_ATV2_EU-user 9 PTT1.190515.001.S54 672201 release-keys

Apply:   TV_HOST=<tv ip> tools/disable.sh examples/sony-bravia-4k-gb/debloat.txt
Undo:    TV_HOST=<tv ip> tools/restore.sh examples/sony-bravia-4k-gb/debloat.txt
Everything is DISABLED, not uninstalled. Comment out any line you want to keep.

Same platform and firmware build as examples/sony-xbr-x900e and the same package set, so this list
is that one with the feature entries at the bottom left enabled. 24 packages disabled, nothing
uninstalled. Stock launcher com.google.android.tvlauncher (the restore.sh default); Live TV and
every HDMI input come from com.sony.dtv.tvx, so keep it. Launcher installed and Home switched,
verified across a reboot. Not lived with for weeks yet: re-enable anything that breaks with
`pm enable <package>`, or tools/restore.sh with this file.

Left enabled on purpose because they are features, not bloat: Chromecast built-in, screen mirroring,
DLNA renderer, Android TV phone remote, USB Media Player and music player. Uncomment the last group
to disable them too.
